rules: Choose a template that matches the business niche and mobile use case.
Record the exact source URL and license or usage terms before adapting it.
Do not copy a competitor's branding, photos, text, logo, or business identity.
Use editor-only Canva, Figma, or Wix templates as visual references unless code/export rights allow reuse.
Prefer an original implementation when license terms are unclear.

sources.name: FreeWebsiteTemplates
sources.default_license_note: Review the individual template terms before commercial delivery.

sources.name: GitHub website-template topic
sources.default_license_note: Use only repositories with a clear license compatible with adaptation and commercial work.

sources.name: ThemeWagon

sources.name: Figma Community
sources.default_license_note: Treat as a design reference unless the file explicitly grants reusable/exportable rights.

sources.name: Canva templates
sources.default_license_note: Use only within Canva or with a license that permits the intended website delivery.

sources.name: Wix templates
sources.default_license_note: Do not extract Wix assets or code unless the platform terms explicitly permit it.
